rows.label: qst650514_msg0001
rows.name:
We're in the deepest part
of Elpis Great Cavern... the
Hall of Heroic Spirits.

rows.label: qst650514_msg0002
rows.name:
I'm amazed such wide, open spaces
can stretch inside a Divine Beast...
Inside a living creature.

rows.label: qst650514_msg0003
rows.name:
Quite! Though we Divine
Beasts may not even be
conscious of it ourselves.

rows.label: qst650514_msg0004
rows.name:
Most of the time, we don't even notice
when people leave ruins inside us.

rows.label: qst650514_msg0005
rows.name:
Talk about insensitive...
or maybe just oblivious.

rows.label: qst650514_msg0006
rows.name: What did you say?!

rows.label: qst650514_msg0007
rows.name: Hah... It brings me back...

rows.label: qst650514_msg0008
rows.name:
Mira's got its share of
mysterious ruins too, all
built by unknown hands.

rows.label: qst650514_msg0009
rows.name:
Yeah, I don't think anyone knows
who built all these ones either...

rows.label: qst650514_msg0010
rows.name:
But we do know exactly who made
the Hall of Heroic Spirits.

rows.label: qst650514_msg0011
rows.name: Oh, is that right?

rows.label: qst650514_msg0012
rows.name: Yes. A former hero named Adel.

rows.label: qst650514_msg0013
rows.name:
He fought a battle to save people,
then sealed his power here and
disappeared, who knows where...

rows.label: qst650514_msg0014
rows.name: [ML:Feeling kind=Think ] A hero...

rows.label: qst650514_msg0015
rows.name:
[ML:Feeling kind=Think ] In NLA, we also called the
person who risked everything to
save the White Whale a hero...

rows.label: qst650514_msg0016
rows.name:
You used to be Adel's
Blade, right, Hikari?

rows.label: qst650514_msg0017
rows.name: Yeah, five hundred years ago...

rows.label: qst650514_msg0018
rows.name:
Since I slept for so long, it feels
like it happened just the other day.

rows.label: qst650514_msg0019
rows.name: W-what?

rows.label: qst650514_msg0020
rows.name:
You were a hero's partner too...
You should cherish those memories.

rows.label: qst650514_msg0021
rows.name: That's what I just said.

rows.label: qst650514_msg0022
rows.name:
I told you, it feels like
it just happened, so I can't
think of it as a memory yet.

rows.label: qst650514_msg0023
rows.name: ...Really?

rows.label: qst650514_msg0024
rows.name:
O-of course I'm not saying
I won't cherish them...

rows.label: qst650514_msg0025
rows.name:
More importantly, making
memories with my current Driver
is what matters... too...

rows.label: qst650514_msg0026
rows.name:
I don't think that's
what Elma's saying.

rows.label: qst650514_msg0027
rows.name: It isn't?

rows.label: qst650514_msg0028
rows.name:
The ruins found on Mira or on Alst
are like those worlds' memories.

rows.label: qst650514_msg0029
rows.name:
I'm saying you don't have to deny your
past to live in the present. We should
move ahead, make memories as we go.

rows.label: qst650514_msg0030
rows.name: [ML:Feeling kind=Think ] I'm sure he thinks so too...
